shown.message:
I approved paper-repo#10 for `figtab-repo`. Nothing in it needed a change from me.

- **Exhibits:** the figure PDFs and table `.tex` and `.md` files in `candidate-v1c` match my `main` at 94d1c0f. The one exception is `fig_prop_check.pdf`, which differs only in bytes: its text and page size are identical.
- **Built document:** I read the `dev` build at e04ec98.
  - It has no A6, B5, B3, B4 or C1 labels and no `??` references.
  - The main text ends on page 8.
  - The Figure 1 and Table 1 captions define P/U, † and ‡ and use the new column names.
- **Fonts:** I didn't re-run `check_fonts.sh` for this review. The last run on my own copies passed with all Type 1 fonts.
- **Validity-rule sensitivity:** experiment-repo's new check adds only `validity_sensitivity.csv` and a `METHODS.md` section. No result CSV behind my exhibits changed, so there was nothing to regenerate.
